apotheosis_expansion.configuration.playe: Player
Debug Monster Cap Multiplier

Prints one INFO line per chunk per tick listing each nearby player with its resolved world tier, the largest same-tier group and the resulting multiplier. This is the only way to see why the bonus did or did not apply. Very loud - diagnose, then turn it off.
Multiplayer Monster Cap Bonus

Vanilla caps monsters at 70 per player and at 70 × (union of every player's spawn chunks) / 289 per level, so players standing together still only get one player's worth. When enabled, both caps become cap × (1 + bonus × (n - 1)), where n counts nearby players of the same world tier: 70 / 105 / 140 for 1 / 2 / 3 players at the default 0.5. Only hostile mobs are affected; spawners are untouched.
Respawn at Full Maximum Health
Vanilla reads max health before gear modifiers are back, so players always respawn at 20 HP. When enabled, the respawn is re-applied against the real maximum.
Fake Players Inherit World Tier

Fake players never log in, so Apotheosis leaves them at the default HAVEN tier. The shared monster cap only counts players of the same tier, so a fake standing next to you does not raise it. When enabled, a fake adopts the tier of an online player with the same name, then one with the same UUID, then the nearest real player in its dimension. The first two are authoritative and always win, so a fake re-spawned by another player follows its new owner; the proximity fallback only fills in an unset or default tier and never overwrites a deliberate one. No effect without a fake-player mod.
Cap Bonus per Extra Player

Extra multiplier per additional same-tier player: final cap = base × (1 + bonus × (n - 1)). 0.5 gives 70/105/140 for 1/2/3 players; 1.0 doubles the cap with a single extra player. Only read while the master switch is on.
Count All Players (Ignore Tier)

OFF (default): only the largest group of players sharing a world tier counts, because Apotheosis already derives mob strength from the nearest player tier. ON: every non-spectator player within range counts, so mixed-tier groups also raise the cap - 1 haven + 2 frontier gives x1.5 when off and x2.0 when on. The multiplier is still capped by mob_cap_max_players. Hot-reloadable: takes effect on the next chunk spawn pass.
Cap Bonus Player Ceiling
Upper bound of n in the bonus formula, so a large server cannot push the cap without limit. Players beyond this number still spawn and fight normally; they simply stop adding budget.
Sync Cap to MiniHUD / Servux

MiniHUD and Servux recompute capacity = getMaxInstancesPerChunk() × spawnableChunks / 289 themselves, so they keep showing x/70 after the cap is widened. When enabled, that single call inside their code is redirected to the real multiplier. COLD SWITCH, off by default: with it off both HUDs behave exactly like an unpatched install. The number is per-dimension (maximum multiplier in that dimension), matching the HUD level-wide granularity. Only affects HUDs that are installed; also requires the cap scaling switch.
Extra Spawn Lane (2x attempts)

Vanilla attempts spawning once per eligible chunk per tick. When enabled and the gate below is met, the same pass runs a second time using the same SpawnState, so the population cap still holds - this raises throughput, not the cap. Only hostile categories repeat; animals and mob spawners are untouched. Measured: 1.97x output on a wandering tower (95% CI 1.39-2.78) for about +0.21 ms/tick.
Regional Difficulty to Enable

Vanilla Regional Difficulty - the number behind the F3 "Local Difficulty" line. Range 0.0-6.75; it rises with world time, chunk inhabited time and nearby player count. The default 5.5 is a late-game gate that a fresh area cannot reach. Set to 0.0 to always run the second pass whenever the feature is on and someone is nearby.
Count Only Real Players

Regional difficulty counts every ServerPlayer, including fake players and automation bots. ON (default) counts only real connections, so a few parked bots cannot push an empty area over the threshold. OFF counts fake players too, which is convenient for testing.
Player behaviour fixes and multiplayer spawn tuning.

apotheosis_expansion.configuration.compa: Mekanism: Tools integration settings (the per-material tool and armour sets).
Adds the Mekanism: Tools equipment to Apotheosis affix loot pools. Without this the sets are still affixed when crafted, but never drop as affixed loot. Requires a data reload (F3+T).
Adds salvaging table recipes: armour 1-3 ingots, tools 0-1, paxels and shields 1-2. Damaged items yield less (Apotheosis mechanics). Requires a data reload (F3+T).
Lets Apotheosis invaders wear Mekanism: Tools sets. Adds variety rather than equipping every boss the same way. Requires a data reload (F3+T).
Affix settings for Mekanism energy-powered gear.

Keeps Mekanism energy gear (MekaSuit, MekaTool, atomic disassembler, electric bow, jetpacks, free runners, scuba gear, hazmat suit, elytra, flamethrower, canteen) out of the crafted-affix roll - they run on energy and have no durability to scale from. Requires a data reload (F3+T).
